# Archimedes

> Turns a natural-language investment intent into a research-grounded,
> rigor-gated portfolio strategy on Arc public testnet (chain ID 5042002).
> Generation is not anchored on-chain. Simulated paper deployments are live:
> `paper_daily_returns` is the graded track record the rigor gate sees.
> `paper_agent_trades` (PR #1704, not on main) is not a live path. Neither is
> on-chain execution proof. Do not round this up into paper trading validating
> on-chain execution.
> Executing strategies in non-custodial USDC vaults on Arc is roadmap, not shipped:
> the contracts are deployed, the journey is gated off every shipped surface, and no
> user vault has ever been created.

Same journey is driveable over HTTP. Better Auth user is canonical application identity.
Wallet is optional verified external account and is required only for wallet/on-chain
operations. Circle wallet passkeys control Circle wallets; they do not log in to Archimedes.

## Agent journey

1. **Read** — public:
   - `GET https://archimedes-arc.com/api/strategies/`
   - `GET https://archimedes-arc.com/api/explore/assets`
   - `GET https://archimedes-arc.com/api/health`
2. **Authenticate** — retain cookies on one HTTP client:
   - `GET /api/auth/providers`
   - existing account: `POST /api/auth/sign-in/email` with
     `{ "email": "...", "password": "..." }`
   - new account: `POST /api/auth/sign-up/email` with
     `{ "name": "...", "email": "...", "password": "..." }`, then sign in
   - confirm: `GET /api/auth/get-session`
3. **Generate** — price it first with public `GET /api/generate/quote`, then
   `POST /api/generate/start` with `brief.intent` and
   `brief.risk_appetite`; tail `GET /api/generate/stream/{job_id}` as SSE.
4. **Rigor** — `GET /api/generate/jobs/{job_id}/candidates`, then
   `GET /api/strategies/{strategy_id}`. `rigor_gate_status` is `pass`, `fail`,
   `pending`, or `degenerate` (real returns exist but are a mathematically
   constant zero-variance series — broken data or a zero-trade backtest, never
   deployable); never infer admission from headline Sharpe alone.
5. **Paper trade** — live today as simulated deployments
   (`POST /api/paper/deployments`). The live graded book is `paper_daily_returns`.
   `paper_agent_trades` is an executor ledger (PR #1704, not on main) and is
   **not** this step. Neither is on-chain execution proof. Do not round this
   up into “paper trading validates the vault” — vault execution is roadmap,
   not shipped.
   `POST /api/paper/deployments` with `{ "strategy_id": "..." }`, then
   `GET /api/paper/deployments/{deployment_id}` to read performance and
   `POST /api/paper/deployments/{deployment_id}/stop` to end it.
6. **Wallet operations** — first link wallet using proof flow below. Publish/subscribe
   are not a public surface — marketplace is roadmap, not shipped. Deploying into a
   vault is roadmap, not shipped: `POST /api/vaults/create` resolves and its contracts are
   deployed, but the journey is gated off every shipped surface and no user vault has ever
   been created — do not describe it to a user as something they can do today.

## Account + rigor utilities (account session required)

- `GET /api/account/usage` — today's generation usage against both daily caps (`user`
  and `ip`) plus live `quote`. `used` is `null`, never a fabricated `0`, when quota
  backend is unreachable. Read it before `POST /api/generate/start` to avoid a 429.
- `POST /api/rigor/verify` — run gate's admission checks over bare returns series you
  submit: `{ "returns": [{ "date": "...", "daily_return": ... }], "trials": N }`. Rate
  limited `5/minute`. DSR and walk-forward OOS are evaluable; PBO and look-ahead audit
  always report `not_evaluable` — bare series carries no selection set and no code.
  `passes` is a QUORUM over the two runnable legs: true only when DSR and OOS both ran
  and passed. Since PBO and look-ahead can never run here the verdict is CAPPED and is
  not the strategy passport's gate. Read `legs_evaluated` / `legs_runnable` /
  `legs_total` / `verdict_capped` alongside it; `passes` alone overstates the evidence.
  MINIMUM EVALUATION WINDOW: 250 daily bars (one trading year). Under it you get a
  422 refusal — `detail.reason: "window_too_short"` with `bars_received` and
  `bars_required` — and never a verdict, so send more history rather than retrying.
  Dates must be strict `YYYY-MM-DD`, unique and ASCENDING (the walk-forward split is
  positional; an out-of-order series is refused, never sorted), and every
  `daily_return` finite with `|r| <= 1.0`.

## Optional wallet link (EIP-4361)

Account session must already exist.

1. `POST /api/wallets/challenge` with
   `{ "address": "0x...", "chain_id": 5042002, "provider": "headless" }`.
   `provider` is provenance only: `metamask` | `browser` | `circle` | `headless`. An API
   client sends `headless` — the other three name browser wallet software it lacks.
2. Sign exact returned `message` with wallet. Do not rebuild it client-side.
3. `POST /api/wallets/verify` with returned message and signature.
4. `GET /api/wallets` confirms verified link.

Challenge is user-bound, domain/URI/chain-bound, five-minute, and single-use. Linking never
creates account session and never transfers wallet already linked to another user.

## Funding test wallet

Arc testnet uses USDC as gas. Faucet: **https://faucet.circle.com/**. No mainnet money; generation still settles real testnet USDC — read `GET /api/generate/quote`.
